classification_contract: Every baseline site is classified by the per-path counts below. Adapter conversions preserve the prior bound-owner result set. The remaining principal-foundation, attribution, membership-hash, and row-correlation queries are named exceptions because they do not authorize rows through a legacy OwnerContext owner key. No conversion changes behavior in this branch.

result_set_contracts.personal_only: Runtime, project, watcher, and structured-finding lookups continue to match the supplied session identity without adding a team predicate.
result_set_contracts.team_capable_null_or_empty: AI run, project, and assist queries match team_id in team scope or session_id with a NULL or empty team marker in personal scope.
result_set_contracts.team_capable_empty: Risk acknowledgement matches team_id in team scope or the exact session owner with an empty team marker in personal scope.
result_set_contracts.exact_legacy_compound_owner: Risk escalation state and deduplication remain named exceptions so they continue to match the exact stored legacy session, team, and record keys without adding request-identity validation.
result_set_contracts.team_only: Team detail, active-owner protection, and recovery-code rotation continue to match the supplied team id without inventing a personal owner column.
result_set_contracts.principal_foundation: Principal, personal-workspace, credential, and credential-scope queries remain inside the additive authentication storage boundary until Phase 3B activates those owners.
result_set_contracts.named_exceptions: Watcher backfill keeps its cross-table owner correlation, audit browsing keeps attribution-only filters, and team membership discovery keeps the legacy one-way token-hash lookup until Phase 3B.

coverage.list_detail: AI assists and context, runtime history and counts, project latest-run selection, team detail, risk state, and structured findings.
coverage.mutation: Risk acknowledgement, team last-owner protection, team-member removal, and recovery-code rotation retain their exact owner boundaries.
coverage.import_export: The remaining surfaces do not add a separate owner-scoped import or export path; audit browsing and AI context reads preserve their existing filters.
coverage.cleanup_retention: Team recovery rotation and the watcher project-id backfill retain their existing team and row-correlation boundaries.
coverage.worker: AI assist queue reads and risk state deduplication continue to use the current session or team owner; principal storage remains additive and inactive as an ownership source.
